hybrid_policy.rule: A hybrid CV must declare one dominant identity. The secondary identity may change at most one capability category and one proof point, and must be required by the job description.

forecasting_data_scientist.label: Forecasting Data Scientist
forecasting_data_scientist.default_headline: Forecasting Data Scientist | Demand Modelling, MLOps and Decision Support
forecasting_data_scientist.problem_class: forecasting demand, prices and operational outcomes under uncertainty
signature_evidence_preferences: Production deployment, monitoring and drift detection

data_engineer.label: Data Engineer
data_engineer.default_headline: Data Engineer | Python, SQL, Azure and Reliable Data Pipelines
data_engineer.problem_class: building reliable data pipelines and model-ready data products
signature_evidence_preferences: Validation for missing timestamps, duplicates, stale feeds, units and schema changes
Migration from Access and spreadsheets into Python, SQL and Snowflake
Production ETL and ELT work at Infosys
Logging, monitoring, backfills and layered data architecture

energy_market_analyst.label: Energy Market Analyst
energy_market_analyst.default_headline: Energy Market Analyst | Power Forecasting, Pricing and Risk Analytics
energy_market_analyst.problem_class: explaining and forecasting power-market outcomes for pricing and risk decisions
signature_evidence_preferences: Commercial shape meetings, pricing and accrual decisions
project_preferences: Energy Market Intelligence and Risk Analytics

football_research_engineer.label: Football Research Engineer
football_research_engineer.default_headline: Football Research Engineer | Applied ML, Analytics Products and Full-Stack Delivery
football_research_engineer.problem_class: turning football research questions into evaluated models and analyst-facing products
signature_evidence_preferences: Same-sample comparison against an incumbent metric
Possession, passing-lane or opponent-adjusted metric development
Testing, experiment tracking and honest negative findings
